title: Persona Contact Get — payload
description: Read one contact — the current revision by default, or a named earlier one — with the holder's own annotations on it.

rev.description: A specific revision. Omit for the current one. Naming a reaped revision is an error rather than a silent fall back to the nearest survivor — a caller comparing against history must know when the history is gone.

includeHistory.description: When true, return the revision metadata (numbers and timestamps) without their documents, so a producer can render a timeline cheaply and fetch only the revision the holder opens.

Response.title: Persona Contact Get — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/contact/get. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/contact/get/1.1#response. The annotations are the contact's current ones whichever revision was asked for: they belong to the contact, not to a revision.

subjectDid.description: The DID the contact disclosed. Absent for a contact made from a community directory entry whose DID the holder has not been shown (persona/contact/put/1.1, linking form).

starred.description: Whether the holder has starred the contact. Always present: an unstarred contact says `false`, so a consumer never has to guess what absence means.

petname.description: The holder's private name for the contact. Absent when they gave none.

lists.description: The holder's lists the contact is on. Absent when it is on none.

directoryRef.description: The community directory entry the holder linked the contact to. Absent when there is no link.

history.description: Present only when `includeHistory` was true. Revision metadata without documents — a timeline is cheap and the documents behind it are not.
